description_en: Query the statistics information of mitigation sessions for the Anti-DDoS plan
description_zh: 查询DDoS高防的抗D包防护次数统计信息
name: DescribeDefenseCountStatistics

parameters.help_en: The source IP of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter because the system automatically retrieves it
parameters.help_zh: 请求源IP。无需填写，系统自动获取
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

DefenseCountTotalUsageOfCurrentMonth.description_en: The number of mitigation sessions consumed by the Anti-DDoS plan this month
DefenseCountTotalUsageOfCurrentMonth.description_zh: 本月已消耗的抗D包防护次数

FlowPackCountRemain.description_en: The remaining number of mitigation sessions available for the Anti-DDoS plan
FlowPackCountRemain.description_zh: 剩余可用的抗D包防护次数

MaxUsableDefenseCountCurrentMonth.description_en: The maximum number of active mitigation sessions available this month
MaxUsableDefenseCountCurrentMonth.description_zh: 本月最大可用防护次数
